amendments.note: Before the critic and confirmation stages ran (A, AL and C1-verify running, no result read beyond L3 cells of A): (1) critic budget: the baseline-environment reference uses the gap and freeze cells only (natural states in C1 only); ranking uses K 16 per candidate; (2) confirmation selection (a) also covers the freezer side of A cells (a freezer plan beating the policy by >= 0.15 with the interval excluding 0) and breaker options in A cells against the freezer policy, with the same rule as for B and N.

Amendment 2, before stage B ran (A partially read: L3 and L5 cells): EXPLORATORY breaker option concede3 (Last Hit + Safe for at most 3 turns while frozen on, same return conditions as concede) added to stage B (freeze cells and controls), because the 10-turn concede was strongly dominated in A and a brief concession is the fair test of temporary concession. The pre-registered options and rules are unchanged; concede3 is reported as exploratory.

Amendment 3, before stages A2, B and N ran (A read for levels 3 and 5): a single-game trace showed that guard_sel does not trade the walk-up on turn 0 at equal power or at the plausible edge with both champions healthy, because the HP-aware duel edge of the defender in a freeze is slightly negative there (-0.02 equal, -0.002 edge: the minion hit modifier), while the turn-0 walk-up Shove breaks an unguarded freeze. EXPLORATORY freezer option guard_walk (guard_sel without the duel-edge condition, same disengagement and Recall release) added: stage A2 (the A cells, A seeds, guard_walk x the five breaker options, paired with A), stage B (third freezer option) and stage N (fifth freezer option). guard_sel stays the pre-registered selective guard.

Amendment 4, before the confirmation stage ran (A, A2, AL and B read; N and Ab running): the confirmation sample replicates, on independent seeds, every A cell freezer plan (including exploratory guard_walk) against the breaker policy (the pre-registered L3/L5 edge/plaus cells plus all other A cells, so that class-level contrasts are confirmed), the selected B contrasts (rule of the pre-registration), and the N kinds where a freezer plan or breaker option meets the selection rule (same states, new rollout seeds). Only confirmation estimates are reported as established.

Exploratory addition AFTER reading the critic ranking (labelled as such): at the eight constructed Recall-window states the weak side was re-tested with the evasive codes the actor actually uses (LH/SH + Yield) beside LH/SH + Safe, same design and seeds as the ranking (results/m46d/run_rank_yield.py), because the ranking flagged LH-Safe as rarely chosen while the actor puts 52-74% on Yield.
